claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a white bicycle with a blue padded seat, rear rack, fenders, chain guard, grips, and tires.
No size, brand, or model markings are shown to confirm it is for children.
Photos show appearance only, not structural strength.
Photos show visible features but not overall wear or condition grade.

risks.risk: Whether the bicycle is in working order
risks.proof: Video of the bicycle being ridden or pedals and wheels turning freely

risks.risk: Tire tread wear and tube condition
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread and valve stems or tubes
Video of brake levers being applied and wheels stopping
Photo of the frame serial number or manufacturer sticker
Receipts or photos showing replaced or serviced parts

risks.risk: Whether keys or a lock are included
risks.proof: Photo of any lock and keys with the bicycle

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being ridden
Close-up photos of tires, brakes, and frame serial number
Photo of any lock and keys
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a bicycle with visible features, so it can be priced at its worst case; seller condition claims are unproven.
